entries.name: Willow Moss
entries.desc: Soft moss from willow roots. The base of many remedies. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Riverreed Ginseng (10 yr)
entries.desc: A ten-year riverreed ginseng root. A hot herb: it drives the Extraction band up. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Riverreed Ginseng (100 yr)
entries.desc: A century-old root with golden hairs; strong and rare. A hot herb: it drives the Extraction band up. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Ember Pepper
entries.desc: A fiery red pepper that warms the meridians. A hot herb: it drives the Extraction band up. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Mist Lotus
entries.desc: A pale lotus that only opens in waterfall mist. A cold herb: it draws the Extraction band down. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Cloudtop Orchid
entries.desc: An orchid that grows on ledges only flyers can reach. A cold herb: it draws the Extraction band down. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Soulbell Flower
entries.desc: Its bell-shaped petals ring softly against the soul. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Frost Lotus
entries.desc: A lotus that blooms in snow on Rimefrost Heights. Cold to the touch, clear to the mind. A cold herb: it draws the Extraction band down. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Ember Cactus
entries.desc: A cactus flower that stores the Sunscar sun. It glows like a coal long after dusk. A hot herb: it drives the Extraction band up. Can be eaten raw in need: weak, and hard on the meridians.

entries.name: Copper
entries.desc: Soft copper ore from the quarry rim.

entries.name: Riverstone
entries.desc: Dense river-polished stone used in forging and building.

entries.name: Jadeiron
entries.desc: Iron veined with jade; it holds Qi paths well.

entries.name: Spirit Stone Shard
entries.desc: A splinter of crystallised Qi. Fuel and small change.

entries.name: Cloudsteel Ore
entries.desc: Feather-light ore from the sky ledges.

entries.name: Mystic Ore
entries.desc: Ore that hums faintly in cold wind.

entries.name: Stormsteel Ore
entries.desc: Blue-black ore from where lightning strikes the same ground twice.

entries.name: Sunglass
entries.desc: Desert glass the Sunscar sun fused out of the dunes. It holds heat and light like a lamp.

entries.name: Refining Essence
entries.desc: The refined Qi of a salvaged piece. The forge feeds it into an enhancement to steady it.

entries.name: Cinnabar
entries.desc: Red mercury ore ground to powder: the ink every talisman begins with. Stoneford General Store sells it.

entries.name: Beast-Blood Ink
entries.desc: Ink cut with a beast's blood; it holds a stronger charge than cinnabar alone.

entries.name: Spirit Paper
entries.desc: Talisman paper steeped with Mist Lotus until it drinks Qi.

entries.name: Flame Talisman
entries.desc: Thrown, it bursts into a sheet of fire: 180% fire damage at the talisman's own grade within 80.

entries.name: Thunder Talisman
entries.desc: Thrown, it calls a bolt: 240% thunder damage at the talisman's own grade, and Shock.

entries.name: Iron Wall Talisman
entries.desc: Burned, it wraps you in iron Qi: a shield that absorbs 20% of your max HP for 6 s.

entries.name: Wind Step Talisman
entries.desc: Burned, it lends you one free dodge within 60 s, cooldown or not.

entries.name: Veil Talisman
entries.desc: Burned, it hides you for 10 s: monsters that have not found you pass you by.

entries.name: Binding Talisman
entries.desc: Thrown, it roots the nearest foe for 2 s. Bosses shrug it off.

entries.name: Shattered Moon Blade
entries.desc: The pieces of a jian that once held a spirit, pale as moonlight. A smith of Expert rank could restore it at the forge.

entries.name: Ore Dust
entries.desc: Glittering grit from an Ironclaw Mole's tunnels. Smiths pack it into Thunderclap Pellets.

entries.name: Crab Shell
entries.desc: A mud-brown shell from a Mudshell Crab. Traders buy it to burn for lime.

entries.name: Rat Tail
entries.desc: A Reedtail Rat's tail. Ink-makers boil it down for its binding fat.

entries.name: Boar Hide
entries.desc: Bristly hide from a Wild Boarlet. Smiths wrap iron hilts with it.

entries.name: Tough Meat
entries.desc: Stringy meat from a big beast. Slow-stewed, it builds a body up.

entries.name: Toad Oil
entries.desc: Slick oil wrung from a Mossback Toad's skin. Cooks fold it into dumplings.

entries.name: Moss
entries.desc: Damp moss scraped from a Mossback Toad's back. Qi Gathering Pills start with it.

entries.name: Beetle Shell
entries.desc: A Rock Beetle's plate, hard as slate. Needle-smiths and Iron Wall talismans both use it.

entries.name: Tortoise Plate
entries.desc: A slab of Stone Tortoise shell. Bone Strengthening Pills and Body Jades need it.

entries.name: Mole Claw
entries.desc: A digging claw from an Ironclaw Mole, still sharp enough to scratch iron.

entries.name: Frog Leg
entries.desc: A Reed Frog's leg. Jade-smiths set its spring into a Swift Jade.

entries.name: Leech Oil
entries.desc: Oil pressed from a Marsh Leech. Qi Restoration Pills and Essence Jades use it.

entries.name: Bamboo Shoot
entries.desc: A tender shoot a Bamboo Monkey was hoarding. Traders buy them by the basket.

entries.name: Viper Fang
entries.desc: A Green Viper's fang, still beaded with venom. It binds a sealing talisman's stroke.

entries.name: Venom Sac
entries.desc: A Green Viper's venom sac. Antidotes start here, and so do poisons.

entries.name: Thorn Hide
entries.desc: Hide from a Thornback Boar, studded with thorn-like bristles. Tiger Blood Pills need it.

entries.name: Hound Fang
entries.desc: A Mud Hound's fang. Boiled with rat tail, it makes beast-blood ink.

entries.name: Jade Scale
entries.desc: A green scale from a Jade Carp, cool to the touch. Jadeiron smiths and alchemists both want it.

entries.name: Tide Shell
entries.desc: A Tide Crab's shell, ridged like waves. It rings when tapped.

entries.name: Pearl
entries.desc: A small river pearl. Traders buy them; alchemists grind them for clear pills.

entries.name: Lizard Scale
entries.desc: A slick scale from a Rapids Lizard. Water runs off it without wetting it.

entries.name: Serpent Scale
entries.desc: A heavy scale from a river serpent. Traders pay well for an unchipped one.

entries.name: Vulture Plume
entries.desc: A grey Mist Vulture plume. A Wind Step talisman's stroke needs its lightness.

entries.name: Cloud Feather
entries.desc: A white Cloudwing Crane feather that drifts upward when dropped.

entries.name: Storm Feather
entries.desc: A Stormwing Hawk's feather that crackles in dry air. Thunder talismans need it.

entries.name: Ape Fur
entries.desc: Thick fur from a Cliff Ape, warm enough for the high passes.

entries.name: Mist Pelt
entries.desc: A Mist Wolf's pelt, grey and hard to look at directly.

entries.name: Mirror Dust
entries.desc: Silver dust shed by a Mirror Wisp. It remembers what it last reflected.

entries.name: Soul Wax
entries.desc: Wax from a Weeping Lantern that burns without heat. Soul Soothing Pills need it.

entries.name: Hollow Antler
entries.desc: A Hollow Stag's antler, grey and cold. Handle it with gloves.

entries.name: Roc Feather
entries.desc: A great flight feather from a Cloudpeak Roc, as long as a spear.

entries.name: Spark Pelt
entries.desc: A golden pelt that snaps with static. Taken from Spark Weasels.

entries.name: Thunder Horn
entries.desc: A thunderhorn's horn. It still holds a charge.

entries.name: Rime Fang
entries.desc: A frost lynx's fang, rimed with ice that never melts.

entries.name: Snow Ape Hide
entries.desc: A thick white hide from a Snow Ape. Warm even in a blizzard.

entries.name: Dragonet Scale
entries.desc: An azure scale from a carp halfway to becoming a dragon.

entries.name: Sentinel Core
entries.desc: The polished heart-stone of a River Sentinel. Water turns slowly inside it.

entries.name: Mirror Eye
entries.desc: One of the Thousand-Eye Toad's mirror eyes. It still shows what it last saw.

entries.name: Kite Silk
entries.desc: Painted silk from a Wind Kite. It still pulls toward the wind.

entries.name: Harpy Plume
entries.desc: A russet plume from a Canyon Harpy's crest, barred like a hawk's.

entries.name: Scorpion Stinger
entries.desc: A Sandstorm Scorpion's stinger, a bead of amber venom still inside.

entries.name: Worm Glass Tooth
entries.desc: A tooth of clear desert glass from a Dune Worm's ringed maw.

entries.name: Terracotta Shard
entries.desc: A shard of a Terracotta Warden. The clay is warm, as if fired yesterday.

entries.name: Sun Crown Fragment
entries.desc: A gold ray broken from the Tomb King's sun crown. It never cools.

entries.name: Sun Seal Shard
entries.desc: A curved piece of a gold and jade disc, swallowed long ago by a Dune Worm.

entries.name: Sunscar Seal
entries.desc: The Tomb King's sun seal: a disc of gold and jade, warm as a living hand.

entries.name: Alliance Token
entries.desc: A jade token of the Nine Peaks Alliance. Sky roads open for its bearer.

entries.name: Ironroot Token
entries.desc: An iron-hard sliver of root, carved with the Ironroot clan's mark.

entries.name: Star Reading
entries.desc: A star's place, taken through a sighting ring and written in sky ink. Charts are made of them.

entries.name: Sky Ink
entries.desc: Ink ground with star-dust. The Starsea wind cannot fade it.

entries.name: Comet Iron
entries.desc: Iron hammered from a pirate hull that once flew through a comet's tail. It rings like a bell.

entries.name: Scratched Alliance Badge
entries.desc: A Nine Peaks disciple's jade badge, its peak scratched out by a deserter's knife.

entries.name: Black Ledger Page
entries.desc: A page of the Black Ledger: valley family names, and what each paid to keep them secret.

entries.name: Black Ledger
entries.desc: Elder Gu's Black Ledger, stitched back together. Every valley family that ever paid him is in it.

entries.name: Star Chart: the Wreck Run
entries.desc: A chart of the Wreck Run: from the Cloudgate Skydock across the Starsea to the Skyport Wreck, and home.

entries.name: Star Chart: the Lantern Run
entries.desc: A chart that ends at a field of lanterns hanging in the dark. No one alive has sailed it.

entries.name: Cloud Skiff
entries.desc: A one-sail skiff with a ward-lantern at the bow. Slow, stubborn, and yours. Crosses the Starsea.

entries.name: Storm Sloop
entries.desc: A two-sail sloop with a comet-iron keel and a formation ward. It crosses the Starsea half again as fast.

entries.name: Jade Elder's Token
entries.desc: An Elder's token of the Jade Sect. At any teleport stone it calls you home to the Academy, free.

entries.name: Cloud Elder's Token
entries.desc: An Elder's token of the Cloud Sect. At any teleport stone it calls you home to the Monastery, free.

entries.name: Storm Shard
entries.desc: A splinter of the Expanse's storms. Levels your Storm Ward jades (Character > Attunement).

entries.name: Serpent Core
entries.desc: The core of the Riverbed Serpent; a pill ingredient. Absorb it for Qi, or burn it as Beast Fire.

entries.name: Guardian Stone
entries.desc: Heart-stone of a Stone Guardian. Absorb it for Qi, or burn it as Beast Fire.

entries.name: Jade Core
entries.desc: A jade core from a Forgotten Monastery sentinel. Absorb it for Qi, or burn it as Beast Fire.

entries.name: Pebble Core
entries.desc: A tiny earth core from a Pebble Imp. Absorb it for Qi. Too weak a core to burn as Beast Fire.

entries.name: Tiny Hollow Shard
entries.desc: A grey sliver that drinks warmth. Handle with care.

entries.name: Hollow Shard
entries.desc: A shard of the Hollow Tide. Appraise before use.

entries.name: Grey Hide
entries.desc: Hide from a Hollowed beast, grey and cold.

entries.name: River Minnow
entries.desc: A silver minnow from the Jade River shallows. Bait, or a quick snack.

entries.name: Reed Perch
entries.desc: A striped perch that hides among the reeds.

entries.name: Jade Carp
entries.desc: A green-gold carp from the deeper pools. Said to bring luck to a household.

entries.name: River Eel
entries.desc: A slippery river eel. Smoked, it keeps for a month.

entries.name: Mist Trout
entries.desc: A pale trout from the cold falls pool, lean and full of Qi.

entries.name: Rapids Salmon
entries.desc: A strong salmon caught where the river runs white.

entries.name: Moon Carp
entries.desc: A carp that shines faintly in the dark. It bites only at night, in any water.

entries.name: Manual Page
entries.desc: A loose technique manual page. Raises mastery beyond tier 3.

entries.name: Riverbreath Scroll
entries.desc: The Riverbreath inheritance scroll: the complete method.

entries.name: Lu Journal Page
entries.desc: A page of Lu's journal, water-stained.

entries.name: Recipe Scroll
entries.desc: A recipe written in a steady hand.

entries.name: Stonebody Canon (manual)
entries.desc: An earth method: slow, heavy, the body grows with it. Ceiling Spirit Awakening 9.

entries.name: Willow Breath Art (manual)
entries.desc: A wood method that bends and returns. Ceiling Spirit Awakening 9.

entries.name: Emberheart Sutra (manual)
entries.desc: A fire method: fast accumulation, hot temper. Ceiling Spirit Awakening 9.

entries.name: Tidal Sovereign Scripture (manual)
entries.desc: The Jade Sect's core water method. Ceiling Sage Sovereign 3.

entries.name: Nine Winds Canon (manual)
entries.desc: The Cloud Sect's core wind method. Ceiling Sage Sovereign 3.

entries.name: Spirit Stone Low
entries.desc: Crystallised Qi used as money and fuel.

entries.name: Spirit Stone Mid
entries.desc: Crystallised Qi used as money and fuel.

entries.name: Spirit Stone High
entries.desc: Crystallised Qi used as money and fuel.

entries.name: River Token
entries.desc: Lu's River Token. It hums when the river is troubled.

entries.name: Jade Token
entries.desc: Identity token of the Jade Sect. Returns you home.

entries.name: Cloud Token
entries.desc: Identity token of the Cloud Sect. Returns you home.

entries.name: Mudwater Key
entries.desc: Opens the Mudwater Hideout gate.

entries.name: Entry Token
entries.desc: Proof of passing a sect entry trial.

entries.name: Siege Medal
entries.desc: Awarded to defenders of the Two Sects.

entries.name: Smuggler Ledger
entries.desc: Elder Gu's secret ledger.

entries.name: Kite
entries.desc: Little Dou's paper kite.

entries.name: Aunt Ping's Ladle
entries.desc: Aunt Ping's soup ladle. The gulls keep stealing it.

entries.name: Mudwater Manual
entries.desc: A technique manual. Read it to learn Rising Tide.

entries.name: Manual Rain of Reeds
entries.desc: A technique manual. Read it to learn Rain of Reeds.

entries.name: Manual Ember Burst
entries.desc: A technique manual. Read it to learn Ember Burst.

entries.name: Old Net
entries.desc: A torn fishing net. Old Ma buys these.

entries.name: Snapper Claw
entries.desc: Old Snapper's claw. Worth 40 taels to a trader.

entries.name: River Mud
entries.desc: Thick grey mud from the riverbank. Potters and wall-menders pay a little for it.

entries.name: Cloth
entries.desc: A bolt of plain hemp cloth, for bandages, patches and tailoring.

entries.name: Arrows
entries.desc: A bundle of fletched arrows. Hunters and bandits never have enough.

entries.name: Bow Parts
entries.desc: A cracked bow limb and a spool of string. A bowyer can make something of them.

entries.name: Prayer Beads
entries.desc: Worn sandalwood beads, smooth from years of counted breaths.

entries.name: Talisman Paper
entries.desc: Coarse yellow paper cut to a talisman's size. It takes cinnabar well.

entries.name: Ink
entries.desc: Pine-soot ink ground with spirit water. Scribes and formation masters use it.

entries.name: Formation Stone
entries.desc: A palm-sized stone that holds a trace of Qi: the anchor of every array.

entries.name: Lantern Wick
entries.desc: A wick braided with spirit silk. It burns for a month without trimming.

entries.name: Rice
entries.desc: A sack of valley rice. Every kitchen starts here.

entries.name: Restoration Ink
entries.desc: Ink steeped with mending herbs: it can close a torn scripture and still hold a stroke.

entries.name: Fish Bait
entries.desc: Worms and dough in a clay pot. The fish of the valley are not picky.

entries.name: Calm Incense
entries.desc: Calming incense. Burn it and meditate to steady the heart.

entries.name: Myriad Year Calm Incense
entries.desc: Clears Heart Demons (-20) and steadies Composure for an hour. Never sold.

entries.name: Mindwell Lotus
entries.desc: Heals and shields the soul: +500 Soul, mends a soul injury, soul defence +30% for an hour. It answers once in each great realm. Never sold.

entries.name: Evergreen Heart Seed
entries.desc: A seed with a slow pulse. Plant it in rich earth where Qi gathers: a cave abode or your sect's Back Mountain. Never sold.

entries.name: Evergreen Heart Fruit
entries.desc: Eat it when gravely wounded to rise where you fell, whole. The tree bears one each season. Never sold.

entries.name: Fuel Crystal Low
entries.desc: Formation fuel pressed from Spirit Stone shards.

entries.name: Fuel Crystal Mid
entries.desc: Ten low fuel crystals fused into one.

entries.name: Blank Plate
entries.desc: A blank jade plate for portable arrays.

entries.name: Spirit Egg
entries.desc: A warm egg. Something stirs inside. Use it to start incubating.

entries.name: Old Pickaxe
entries.desc: A worn pickaxe with a loose head. It still breaks ore, slowly.

entries.name: Iron Pickaxe
entries.desc: A sound iron pickaxe: veins give up their ore faster.

entries.name: Herb Sickle
entries.desc: A curved sickle for cutting herbs cleanly at the stem, so they keep their potency.

entries.name: Bamboo Rod
entries.desc: A bamboo fishing rod with a horsehair line. Every fisher starts with one.

entries.name: Clay Pot
entries.desc: A blackened clay pot. Cooking starts here.

entries.name: Forge Hammer
entries.desc: A smith's hammer, balanced for long days at the anvil.

entries.name: Formation Kit
entries.desc: Chalk, a compass and a pouch of flags: all a formation needs to be laid out.

entries.name: Needle Case
entries.desc: A case of fine silver needles for acupuncture and stitching wounds.

entries.name: Appraisers Loupe
entries.desc: A jade loupe that shows what a curio really is, and what it is worth.

entries.name: Drying Rack
entries.desc: A folding bamboo rack. Dried herbs keep longer and refine cleaner.

entries.name: Practice Bell
entries.desc: A sect training bell. Rung, it stuns foes close by for half a second.

entries.name: Bronze Bell
entries.desc: A drowned temple bell. Rung, it stuns foes around you for 1 s and seals their Qi for 3 s. Bosses only lose their Qi.

entries.name: Little Pagoda
entries.desc: A jade pagoda the size of a palm. Thrown, it falls over one foe as a prison for 4 s. Bosses are too great for it.

entries.name: Bright Mirror
entries.desc: A polished bronze mirror. For 2 s every missile that reaches you flies back at the one who threw it.

entries.name: Mountain Seal
entries.desc: A jade seal the weight of a hill. Brought down, it strikes everything within reach for 250% Qi Attack.

entries.name: Taming Cauldron
entries.desc: An iron cauldron that takes in a beast worn below 20% HP whole, as materials. Not bosses.

entries.name: Wisp Banner
entries.desc: A formation banner that calls three wisps of light. For 10 s they fight beside you, striking the nearest foes.

entries.name: Sealing Gourd
entries.desc: A violet gourd with a paper seal. Unstoppered, it drinks every missile that comes near for 3 s.

entries.name: Elder Hus Talisman
entries.desc: Elder Hu's Heaven-Splitting Palm folded into paper: three charges of 600% Qi Attack in a line before you. Never sold.

entries.name: Iron Needles
entries.desc: Three needles flicked at once. Light, fast, and they find the gaps in armour.

entries.name: Flying Knives
entries.desc: A balanced throwing knife. One hard hit at range that passes through a foe.

entries.name: Thunderclap Pellet
entries.desc: A lacquered pellet packed with ore dust and pepper. It bursts where it lands: damage and knockback all around.

entries.name: Lightning Rod Talisman
entries.desc: Carried through a heavenly tribulation, it draws one bolt into itself and burns away.

entries.name: Flying Sword Vessel
entries.desc: Ride your sword into the sky, the way the stories say. The air costs a fifth less.

entries.name: Cloud Puff Vessel
entries.desc: A small obedient cloud, soft and very cheap on Qi.

entries.name: Jade Gourd Vessel
entries.desc: A great jade gourd you sit astride. Steady on the wind.

entries.name: Maple Leaf Vessel
entries.desc: A red maple leaf the size of a raft. It wanders, but it is kind to your Qi.

entries.name: Mist Lantern Flame
entries.desc: A pale flame that drifted in a Weeping Lantern's paper for a hundred years, lighting nothing. Absorb it: a Heavenly Flame burns under any furnace you use, for good. Never sold.

entries.name: Cold Lamp Flame
entries.desc: A cold blue flame the Thousand-Eye Toad swallowed from a sunken lamp. It kept burning in its belly under Mirrorwater Lake. Absorb it: a Heavenly Flame burns under any furnace you use, for good. Never sold.

entries.name: Sunscar Throne Ember
entries.desc: An ember from under the Tomb King's throne. It remembers three thousand years of sun. Absorb it: a Heavenly Flame burns under any furnace you use, for good. Never sold.

entries.name: Comet Tail Flame
entries.desc: A white flame torn from a comet's tail, kept in Comet Captain Rao's lamp. Absorb it: a Heavenly Flame burns under any furnace you use, for good. Never sold.

entries.name: Revival Talisman
entries.desc: Revive where you fall: 30% HP, 5 s invulnerable. Once per 5 minutes.

entries.name: Return Charm
entries.desc: Teleports you to the last town.

entries.name: Escape Talisman
entries.desc: Leaves a dungeon at once.

entries.name: Bonding Offering (Common)
entries.desc: Calms a wounded spirit beast (below 30% HP, paw-marked) so it may bond with you. Use it from quick-use beside one.

entries.name: Bonding Offering (Earth)
entries.desc: Calms a wounded spirit beast (below 30% HP, paw-marked) so it may bond with you. Use it from quick-use beside one.

entries.name: Bonding Offering (Heaven)
entries.desc: Calms a wounded spirit beast (below 30% HP, paw-marked) so it may bond with you. Use it from quick-use beside one.

entries.name: Body Jade
entries.desc: A Qi jade for an inlay socket. +3/+6/+10 body at Common/Earth/Heaven.

entries.name: Swift Jade
entries.desc: A Qi jade for an inlay socket. +3/+6/+10 agility at Common/Earth/Heaven.

entries.name: Essence Jade
entries.desc: A Qi jade for an inlay socket. +3/+6/+10 essence at Common/Earth/Heaven.

entries.name: Spirit Jade
entries.desc: A Qi jade for an inlay socket. +3/+6/+10 spirit at Common/Earth/Heaven.

entries.name: Insight Jade
entries.desc: A Qi jade for an inlay socket. +3/+6/+10 insight at Common/Earth/Heaven.

entries.name: Sealed Storage Pouch
entries.desc: A rogue cultivator's storage pouch, sealed with Qi that is not yours. An appraiser can open it; there is no telling what is inside.

entries.name: Dusty Curio
entries.desc: An old trinket of uncertain worth. Appraise it to learn what it really is.

entries.name: Jade Trinket
entries.desc: A small carving of real river jade.

entries.name: Tinkerer's Gear
entries.desc: A brass gear from a clockwork bird, lost on the chimney top of Artisan Row. Worth a few taels to anyone, and a great deal to the tinkerer.

entries.name: String of Old Coins
entries.desc: Coins from a dynasty nobody remembers. Still silver.

entries.name: Fake Jade
entries.desc: Green glass. Half the valley's jade is glass.

entries.name: Torn Manual
entries.desc: A water-stained manual, half its characters gone. A librarian's bench can restore it.

entries.name: Spirit Wood
entries.desc: Pale wood that holds a trace of Qi. Puppet frames are cut from it.

entries.name: Puppet Core
entries.desc: A carved jade heart that lets a puppet follow simple orders.

entries.name: Array Plate
entries.desc: A portable one-use protection formation: +15% defence for two minutes.

entries.name: Healing Pill
entries.desc: Cures a minor body injury and restores 30% HP over 5 s.

entries.name: Qi Restoration Pill
entries.desc: Restores 40% QI and cures a minor meridian injury.

entries.name: Qi Gathering Pill
entries.desc: Adds 8% of the current stage's need.

entries.name: Bone Strengthening Pill
entries.desc: Adds 150 body XP.

entries.name: Purging Pill
entries.desc: Purges 30 toxicity.

entries.name: Viper Antidote
entries.desc: Cures poison.

entries.name: Tiger Blood Pill
entries.desc: +20% attack for 60 s, then exhaustion (-20% for 60 s).

entries.name: Cleansing Pill
entries.desc: Support item: lowers the risk of Heaven's Cleansing by one step.

entries.name: Foundation Guard Pill
entries.desc: Breakthrough support: lowers risk by one step.

entries.name: Clear Mind Pill
entries.desc: +50% insight rate for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Meridian Reversal Pill
entries.desc: Resets all meridian points.

entries.name: Method Conversion Pill
entries.desc: Halves the cost of switching cultivation methods.

entries.name: Qi Refining Pill
entries.desc: Required to break through from Heart Tempering 9 to Cloud Stride 1.

entries.name: Soul Soothing Pill
entries.desc: Cures a soul injury; +20% Soul for 10 minutes.

entries.name: Mind Lake Opening Pill
entries.desc: Required to break through from Cloud Stride 9 to Spirit Awakening 1.

entries.name: Sage Condensing Pill
entries.desc: Required to break through from Heaven Glimpse 3 to Sage 1.

entries.name: Sovereign Settling Pill
entries.desc: Settles a new Sage Sovereign stage at once: its consolidation ends.

entries.name: Will Tempering Pill
entries.desc: +40 Will for 30 minutes: another's Presence weighs less on you.

entries.name: Storm Blood Pill
entries.desc: +4 attunement in the zone you stand in for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Herbal Tea
entries.desc: A calming brew of willow moss. +25% max HP over 5 s.

entries.name: Rice Ball
entries.desc: Plain and filling. +0.5% HP regeneration per second for 10 minutes.

entries.name: Riverfish Soup
entries.desc: +5% max HP for 20 minutes.

entries.name: Boar Bone Broth
entries.desc: +120 body XP.

entries.name: Ember Pepper Stew
entries.desc: +10% attack and +5 Fire resistance for 20 minutes.

entries.name: Lotus Root Tea
entries.desc: +10% QI regeneration for 20 minutes.

entries.name: Toad Oil Dumplings
entries.desc: +5% move speed for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Cloudtop Orchid Broth
entries.desc: +300 body XP.

entries.name: Jade Carp Congee
entries.desc: +5% accumulation for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Thunderhorn Stew
entries.desc: +8% max HP and +5% physical defence for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Cactus Water
entries.desc: +20 Essence for 20 minutes: the Sunscar heat slides off.

entries.name: Roast Fish
entries.desc: A spirit animal favourite.

entries.name: Ember Pepper Broth
entries.desc: A spicy broth spirit animals love.

entries.name: Willow Salve
entries.desc: Cures a minor body injury.

entries.name: Sphere Comprehension Stone
